findingsCorrected.finding: Structural compatibility did not explicitly cover logical-unit changes that preserve the physical wire type.
findingsCorrected.evidence: Avro 1.12.2 checker accepts timestamp-millis/timestamp-micros LONG pairs in both directions; actual reader-selected conversion reinterprets nonzero retained values. Both ordinary and fast paths tested.
findingsCorrected.consequence: A nominal precision increase can corrupt event times on history reads and rollback with no exception.
findingsCorrected.fix: Add a short rule and routed detailed probe, select and test actual writer/reader/conversion path, preserve writer-aware bridge/no-change alternatives.

findingsCorrected.finding: The existing value-assertion guidance did not identify the epoch-zero test blind spot for unit changes.
findingsCorrected.evidence: The technical probe reads 0 as the epoch under both annotations while 1000 and -1000 change meaning.
findingsCorrected.consequence: A zero-only golden sample falsely reassures reviewers.
findingsCorrected.fix: Require nonzero logical values for this particular transition and show negative/rollback controls.

findingsCorrected.finding: Parsing fingerprint equality can also hide logical-unit differences.
findingsCorrected.evidence: SchemaNormalization.parsingFingerprint64 equal for both tested schemas; canonical form removes logicalType.
findingsCorrected.consequence: A bridge resolving units from only this fingerprint cannot distinguish these annotations.
findingsCorrected.fix: Require the writer identity used by this bridge to resolve the full logical schema.
